sentences.en: The steep path is the sole access to the border.
sentences.zh: 这条陡峭的小路是通往边境的唯一路径。

sentences.en: A small border dispute ballooned into a major international incident.
sentences.zh: 一个小小的边界争端升级成了重大的国际事件。

sentences.en: The army is in the north to protect the border.
sentences.zh: 军队驻扎在北部以保护边境。
